_note: Knobs for zone.py (ZoneParams) and drops.py (DropParams); partial overrides allowed, a bad file = defaults.

roof._note: roof.py: from start_s, climb a roof inside the next circle and hold it (stand back from the edges)

aggro._note: all-out aggression: fight anything within 230 m, flee only < 25% HP vs 2+, hunt the last known enemy instead of hiding

early_evade._note: Step 2: with aggro on, break off to cover when >= `attackers` different mechs hit us within `window_s` and HP < `hp_frac`. enabled=false restores main.

unseen_hit._note: a mech we can't see hit us within window_s: `cover` = evade to cover that blocks its bearing (unless the target dies within finish_s), `face` = turn the torso to it. enabled=false restores the branch base.

evade_fix._note: once evade starts, stay in it commit_s (unless the target dies within unseen_hit.finish_s); cover search out to the last of radii. enabled=false restores the branch base.
